description: Shared open-now boundary cases (phase 031). Driven by test/working_hours_contract_test.dart (Dart WorkingHours.isOpenAt) and backend/scripts/verify-db.mjs (SQL private.hours_open). Times are India wall-clock minutes since midnight; weekday 1=Monday..7=Sunday. A window with close <= open runs overnight into the next day; close 1439 means until midnight. No rows at all = hours unknown (Dart null, SQL not open-now).
